shots.description: The ranked board: 198 pre-token protocols ordered by implied value, with the category chart, search box and filters above the table.
A protocol detail view for the top-ranked protocol, Steakhouse: the model's inputs and arithmetic, the traded tokens anchoring its multiple, why it ranks first, and its eight-step farm plan.
The board filtered to a single category, showing the search and filter controls in use and the category ranking within the filtered set.
